summary: Wraps listeners, stream connections, packet connections, and TURN relay address generators to count network connections, packets, and bytes in Prometheus.
responsibilities: Wrap accepted TCP connections with telemetry-aware Conn values.
Record connection lifecycle counts for stream and packet connections.
Record incoming and outgoing bytes and packet counts on reads and writes.
Wrap TURN relay address generator allocations with telemetry-aware connection types.
